claim_boundary: Raw precursor/RT linkage establishes feature-level MS2 evidence, not molecular identity.
unresolved_source_local means no deposited reference-spectrum hit in this source; it is not yet a harmonized cross-source unknown partition.
This result alone is not a replicated COVID response and not an unknown-information increment.
Ambiguous multi-feature spectra and blank-only links are excluded from usable representative spectra.
leakage_status: feature links were frozen using only m/z, RT, existing reference-spectrum status, and a phenotype-blind acquisition manifest; response effects were joined afterward

parameters.usable_ms2: at least one unique biological or pooled-QC link; blank-only excluded

published_aggregate_reference.interpretation: The published count is an audit reference, not a target to tune toward; raw linkage may differ because this implementation requires unique 0.005-Da/3-s feature assignment.
